question: Which equation was verified by American scientists Nichols and Hull in 1903 by measuring the radiation pressure of visible light?
solution:
The correct answer is __**P = U/C**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** ​

__
 
• **P = U/C **verified by **American scientists Nichols and Hull **in 1903 by measuring the **radiation pressure of visible light** is the equation proposed by **James Clerk Maxwell**.
 
• This equation relates the intensity of light to its pressure.
 
• It is known as Maxwell's stress tensor equation, which is a part of Maxwell's equations of electromagnetism.
 
• The equation **P = U/C​** is known as the radiation pressure formula.
 
• In this equation: 
 
 
• **P represents the radiation pressure,**
 
• **U represents the energy density of radiation, and**
 
• **C represents the speed of light in a vacuum.**
 
 
 
• This equation describes the pressure exerted by electromagnetic radiation (such as light) on a surface or object. It's an important equation in physics, particularly in fields like optics and astrodynamics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The idea of radiation pressure** emerges from the momentum exchange that takes place between the item and the electromagnetic field.
 
• Since electromagnetic waves carry momentum during transit, this force is visible.
 
• The mechanical pressure that results from the interchange of momentum between an item and the electromagnetic field is known as radiation pressure, and it can be applied to any surface. In this instance, photons striking the object's surface cause a momentum transfer.
 
• Any surface's radiation pressure is influenced by its characteristics and the light source's intensity.
